judge_verdict.reasons_for_rejection: The evaluation plan contains a critical logical error in the 'Checkpoint Verdicts' and fails to utilize the appropriate expert for anatomical verification. Specifically: 1) The Router marked 'Small protrusible mouth' as untestable because it is 'cut off by the left edge', but the provided image clearly shows the fish's head and eye on the LEFT side with the snout fully visible. This indicates a hallucination of the image layout by the Router. 2) The plan relies on `fine_grained_classifier` and `perceptual_quality_auditor` for anatomical checks, but omits `animal_pose_auditor`. While the registry notes 'NOT for limbless (fish)', Angelfish/Rock Beauties have distinct fins (dorsal, anal, pectoral, caudal) that function as limbs for pose/structure auditing. The absence of this expert leaves the structural integrity of the fins (specifically the continuity of the dorsal fin and shape of the tail) under-verified against geometric melting.

audited_plan.image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a Rock Beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor). The image captures the anterior black section of the body and head on the left, transitioning to the posterior golden-yellow section on the right. The eye is partially visible on the far left edge. The dorsal fin runs along the top, and the rounded caudal fin (tail) is clearly visible on the right side, featuring a distinct dark margin.

Correction from previous plan: The posterior end of the fish, including the caudal peduncle and the rounded tail fin, is fully visible on the right side of the image. The shape matches the 'rounded' description.

The texture within the black patch appears somewhat uniform and slightly noisy/grainy rather than showing distinct individual scales, which could be a compression artifact or a subtle AI texture generation issue.
